digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler binding store baseline storage
propositions: Baseline storage currently persists ADF dicts for description and vendor dicts for status/priority, requiring ~18MB file size; normalization to scalar strings (rich text and Jira name) can reduce this by approximately 66% while maintaining semantic equivalence through the live comparison path.

The inbound mapper canonicalizes remote and baseline values identically through normalize_rich_text and _extract_jira_field_value, so storing pre-normalized scalars produces identical compute_update_fields verdicts as storing vendor dicts, verified by live-comparison oracle.

Assignee field must preserve vendor dict shape, all identity forms, and presence semantics to maintain correct outbound suppression logic through _assignee_matches; collapsing to scalar form risks concurrent remote assignee edits being overwritten.

Projection helper in inbound_fields.py must be idempotent on already-scalar values and preserve field absence, enabling safe rollback to pre-A3 code which accepts both scalar and vendor dict shapes for status/priority.

Full-corpus oracle across 1,774 existing baselines must demonstrate zero mutation deltas in both forward (normalized storage) and rollback (pre-A3 code) directions, zero assignee shape changes, and at least 50% byte reduction.
